capabilities: Read EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2, CBZ, PDF and TXT books from a cover-grid shelf
Highlight and comment on passages in five colours with bookmarks
Generate one Markdown note per book with backlinks to each excerpt
Search annotations in a book or the whole vault and export to Markdown or CSV
Review highlights with spaced repetition and track reading stats
extras: Two builds: the community build cannot read PDFs and hands them to the default program; the full build with PDF support is distributed from the companion repository LLllCCC/grove-reader-full. Offline by default, no telemetry, API keys stored in plugin data.
problem: Reading e-books means leaving Obsidian, so highlights and reading notes end up outside the vault and disconnected from its Markdown, links and search.

relations.evidence: foliate-js (MIT, vendored in lib/foliate-js) renders EPUB
PDF reading and annotation are built directly on pdfjs-dist

summary: E-book reader for EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2, CBZ, PDF and TXT that highlights passages and generates one Markdown note per book with backlinks.
